text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Letter of guarantee The guardian should write out his/her name, nationality, occupation and address (if an organization acts as the guardian, reference to the organization should be made clear). 7. Photocopy of valid Visa or Residence Permit For the applicants who are already in China
